senses.gloss:
रोप 1. रोप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रुप् = rt.
1. लुप्), confusing, disturbing; (अम्), n. a fissure,
chasm, hole, cavity, (in this sense possibly connected
with rt. 1. रुह्, cf. रुहक.)

रोप 2. रोप, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus. of rt.
1. रुह्), the act of raising or setting up, &c. (=
2. रोपण); the planting (of trees); an arrow.

1. रोपण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. causing bodily pain,
causing racking or griping pain; (अम्), n. according
to the commentator on Taittirīya-Brāhmaṇa III.
476, 9 = विमोहन or उपद्रव.
रोपि, इस्, f., Ved. acute or racking pain.
1. रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, perplexed.

2. रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to grow; raised,
erected, elevated; set, planted, placed in or upon.

रोपुषी, f., Ved., according to some = रोपि; ac-
cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 191, 13. ‘destroying,’
रोपुषीणाम् = लोपयित्रीणाम् = छेत्त्रीणाम्.

रोपक, अस्, m. a planter [cf. वृक्ष-र्˚]; a
weight of metal or a coin ((1/70) of a Suvarṇa; cf.
रूपक).

रोपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set up or erected or
raised; to be planted; useful for healing or cicatrizing.

रोपयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sets up or erects,
an erecter; a planter.
रोपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raising, erecting, setting, planting.

रोप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be raised or erected; to be
planted.

रोपणाका रोपणाका, f., Ved. a kind of
bird, (Sāy.) a thrush (= शारिका).
